content:
Date: Sunday, June 21, 2026

Selected Approach:
- Reuse the shared partial via @use + *ngIf="editMode" header swap + prefill-snapshot gate

Approved implementation approach:
In the template, wrap a new .blue-hero-header block (matching security-settings' markup — hero-nav / back-btn / centered header-title "Edit Identity" / back-btn-spacer) in *ngIf="editMode", rendered above both step 1 and step 2; keep the existing onboarding header for !editMode. SCSS does @use '../../theme/blue-hero-header' — because the class only exists in the editMode branch it's naturally scoped, so no styles leak into onboarding. For the gate: capture step1Snapshot = JSON.stringify(step1Form.value) right after the Alpaca prefill resolves (the on-file baseline), add a get step1Changed() that compares the live value to it, and in editMode disable the continue button ([disabled]="!step1Valid || !step1Changed") and early-return from proceedToStep2() when editMode && !step1Changed.

Andrew's Answers:
Q: Gate when the prefill is slow or fails. The "changed" check needs the Alpaca-prefilled on-file values as a baseline. If that prefill is still loading — or fails — there's no baseline to diff against. My recommendation: keep the continue button disabled in editMode until the baseline is captured; if the prefill fails, fall back to the existing step1Valid-only gate so the user is never permanently stuck. Optional
  A (Andrew confirmed your prediction): Yes — disabled until the baseline loads; if prefill fails, fall back to the step1Valid-only gate so the user isn't stuck.
Q: Which step-1 fields count as "changed." Diff the entire step-1 form value against the post-prefill snapshot (any step-1 field edit unlocks the gate), or only the subset Alpaca prefilled? My recommendation: diff the whole step1Form.value — simplest and matches "at least one step-1 field changed." Optional
  A (Andrew confirmed your prediction): Diff the whole step1Form value — any step-1 field change counts. No need to restrict to just the Alpaca-prefilled subset.

Proceed with implementation.
